title: JA Vega wp7: category chips are set like the source (no letter-spacing), section pills are pure black, the project band chip is 30px tall, and the site sweep passes on every route
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-vega theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-vega/j6, web fonts loaded).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-vega-wp7 --zip <theme.zip> --out <dir>
S4: Read the summary table and the final line of each command.
expect: site-sweep: overflow, scheme, background, header and chips all report 0 defects and 0 not-measured over 34 routes x 6 widths x light and dark.

Category chips on /portfolio and the six category pages are not letter-spaced (128px wide, not 152px), section pills print in #000, and the 'More our projects' band chip is 30px tall, each as on the source.
measure117: chips-repeated passes (the style guide's repeated 'New' badges equal the source, paired by order); the merged fix-measure.json is 6/6.
evidence: Sweeps of 04/10/2026 against the local Joomla source: on 1.1.6 the chips check found 208 letter-spacing cases on 7 routes and 38 section-pill colour cases on 13 routes; on 1.1.7 all checks pass, 0 not measured (fix-measure.json 6/6, bound to wp-ja-vega-1.1.7.zip c894e323)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the sweep exits non-zero on a defect and on anything it could not measure
